# QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser build of `qrcode-generator` 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT).

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Retrieved 2026-10-26 from the official npm registry. Vendored so desktop builds and QR rendering work offline without a CDN or an online QR service.

SHA-256 (`qrcode.js`): `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`

License: see the copyright notice retained in `qrcode.js` and `LICENSE.qrcode.txt`.
